effect.en: Add 1 "The Flame Dragon Haunting the Temple" or "The Black Witch Facing the Temple" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, if your opponent has a face-up Level 8 or higher monster on their field, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand face-up to your field.
